stories.title: Voting under way in Sweden with far right eyeing first role in government

en.title: Voting under way in Sweden with far right eyeing first role in government
en.summary: Sweden is holding an election featuring an unusually polarized campaign where the far-right Sweden Democrats could enter government for the first time if the rightwing bloc prevails. Polls show an extremely close race between the left and right blocs.
